verdict.rationale: A probe confirmed that https://docs.pipecat.ai/llms.txt returns HTTP 200 with Pipecat-specific content. Pipecat also ships agent-oriented docs: the quickstart scaffold writes AGENTS.md and CLAUDE.md, and `pipecat context-hub` builds a local docs, examples and API index that registers as an MCP server with your coding agent. missing for 10: independent or community reports of agents actually using llms.txt or context-hub, and evidence of the full llms.txt contents and coverage (the probe excerpt is truncated).
